text: On the left side of Ironvale Athletic’s half, near the edge of the penalty area about 7.5 metres from the Redmond Rovers’ goal, Jonah Lindqvist carries the ball forward quickly after a clearance. He makes a short, precise pass to Ilias Thorne positioned more centrally and closer to the goal. Thorne controls it and immediately shoots with his foot, scoring an equaliser to make the score 3-3 in the 86th minute. This goal comes from a fast, two-player counter-attack that breaks through Redmond’s high defensive line[#1532] [#1533] [#1534] [#1537].
